To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the (Ti,AL)N supersaturated (Ti,Al ) N solid solution was formed from the mixture of TiN and ALN powders using a HEBM.

(i) the (Ti, Al)N supersaturated (Ti,Al ) N solid solution was successfully formed by HEBM, (ii) the crystalline size of milled powders after 10 hours of milling is 20 nm and (iii) the crystalline grain size of the (TiAl)N solid solution is about 13 nm after 100 hours milling.
the (Ti, Al)N nano-size powder can be synthesized by mechanical alloying of TiN and AIN powders.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the formation of the supersaturated (Ti,Al )N solid solution from the mechanical alloying of TiN and AIN powders.
the synthesis of supersaturated (Ti,Al,N) solid solutions using HEBM.
the mechanical alloying of the TiN/AlN system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the HEBM is an effective method to form supersaturated solid solution in the Ti-Al-N system.
mechanical alloying using HEBM is an efficient and promising method for the synthesis of (Ti,Al )N solid solution powders.
the (Ti, Al) N supersaturated solid solution was formed by HEBM of TiN and 50 mole% AlN powders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the formation of (Ti,Al,N) solid solution is possible by high energy ball milling of the mixture of AlN and TiN powders.
the (Ti, Al) N solid solution is formed by HEBM of TiN and A1N powders and it can be used as a starting material for the production of (Ti, Al )N thin films.
the formation of the supersaturated solid solution of AlN in TiN matrix is possible by mechanical alloying of TiN and AIN powders.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the formation of (Ti,Al )N supersaturated solid solutions is possible by mechanical alloying of TiN and AIN powders.

the HEBM is a suitable method for the formation of the supersaturated solid solution of (Ti,Al,N) with a high fraction of AlN (up to 60 mole%) and that the fraction of AlN in the (Ti, Al) N solid solution increases with increasing of the AlN fraction in the initial powders.
the (Ti, Al )N supersaturated solid solutions can be obtained from the mechanical alloying of TiN and/or AlN powders.
